fact: In the reporting period 1-28 February 2025, UNICEF and its partners conducted a birth registration campaign in six localities of Red Sea State (Algunub Aloleeb, Sinkat, Sawakin, Haya, Dordaib and Toker), under UNICEF's donor-funded humanitarian response, in which 7,000 children were officially registered and 800 birth certificates were issued; the report does not say how the record was made.
title: Humanitarian Situation Report No. 28
